verdicts.note: Five years of practice, no judicial or pro tem service, first run against a sitting judge (S1). High confidence rests on the record of non-incumbency, a fact rather than an inference.

Permitted evidence type: professional formation (public defender; 'hundreds of bail arguments' as preliminary appearance attorney) and diversion (pledge to 'actively participate in therapeutic courts' with a rehabilitation focus) (S1). Paired with 'requiring accountability for offenses', so 1, not 2.

'A neutral officiant of the law rather than imposing my beliefs from the bench' (S1) is a generic neutrality pledge, not a stated interpretive approach (text and original meaning, or rights-protective reading). Orosco makes the equivalent pledge, a hearing 'free from bias or personal agendas' (her S1), and was rightly left unscored on judicial; _contest.md says neither describes an interpretive approach beyond that. Scoring only Nguyen at medium manufactures a philosophy contrast the dossier does not show. Keep the lean visible at low so it stays out of alignment math.

Sitting presiding judge with a first-term record (Therapeutic Court, more than $1 million in state funding and grants) after 14 years of defense practice, endorsed by 20+ judges (S1, S2). Only one term on the bench, but against a challenger with five years of practice and no judicial service, -2 high is the fair placement.

Defense formation (14 years), created a Therapeutic Court, expanded the work crew program as an alternative to incarceration, and plans a Veterans Court track (S1, S2): all diversion evidence. Her own framing stresses accountability and taxpayer savings, so 1 rather than 2.
